# Yossi Ghinsberg

> Yossi Ghinsberg is a keynote speaker, bestselling author, and real-life survivor. In 1981, at age 22, he survived weeks alone in the Bolivian Amazon rainforest with no food, no fire, and no tools. His memoir Jungle sold over 1 million copies in 20 languages and became the 2017 Hollywood film "Jungle" starring Daniel Radcliffe. Voted Most Unforgettable Speaker by The Sweeney Agency, he has spoken to audiences from 500 to 10,000 people for clients including Google, Apple, Microsoft, BMW, IBM, Coca-Cola, and MDRT, across 55+ countries.

Yossi is based in California, USA. He speaks on survival, resilience, adaptation, and leadership, drawing on lived experience rather than theory. His framework, The Laws of the Jungle, distills principles observed in the Amazon ecosystem into lessons for business and life.

## Keynote Programs

- [Keynote Programs](https://yossighinsberg.com/keynotes): The three signature keynotes: "From Survival to Legacy", "The Laws of the Jungle", and "Real Survival vs Imaginary Survival". Each is customized per event.
- [The Laws of the Jungle](https://yossighinsberg.com/laws): Nine laws of leadership and resilience drawn from the Amazon, each set to an original musical score.
- [FAQ](https://yossighinsberg.com/faq): Booking process, fees, topics, languages, and logistics.

## The Story

- [The Story of Yossi Ghinsberg](https://yossighinsberg.com/story): The 1981 Amazon survival story: the expedition, the separation, the weeks alone, and the rescue led by Kevin Gale.
- [Beyond the Keynote](https://yossighinsberg.com/yossi): The Uchupiamona Nation partnership, Chalalan Ecolodge, and a four-decade relationship with the Amazon.
- [Media & Books](https://yossighinsberg.com/media): The memoir Jungle, the 2017 film starring Daniel Radcliffe, and press coverage.
- [Videos](https://yossighinsberg.com/videos): Speaker reel and keynote footage.
- [Endorsements](https://yossighinsberg.com/endorsements): Client testimonials from Fortune 500 events and global conferences.
